name: re-anchor
description: Discipline correctors that re-anchor a standing rule mid-session, audit the work in flight against it, and correct what has drifted: do-your-research (research and no-assumptions discipline, with a deep subagent-fanned verification pass), follow-our-standards (alignment to the consuming org's engineering conventions), and point-dont-copy (pointer-over-copy discipline — no copied content, internal-name coupling, or closed capability lists). Firing one is a re-anchor, not an accusation; the audit may return clean.
